I wrote the plan for all 8 laws (9 nodes) and the validator accepts every node. One of them, `NRS_484B_627_1c`, carries an atom gap, so it won't be coded until that gap is decided.

| Node | What it checks |
|---|---|
| `NRS_484B_603_1_o1` (surrogate) | Speed under the listed conditions (intersection, curve, hill crest, narrow or winding highway, special hazards). The test is that the stopping distance fits the sight distance and visibility, plus a cornering limit on bends. |
| `NRS_484B_603_1_o2` (surrogate) | Toward a road user in predicted conflict, the subject must be at rest, braking, or able to stop within the gap. Contact while moving is a violation. |
| `NRS_484B_620_2` | Speed must stay within the posted value in a signed speed zone. "Road" is read by its definition, so the rule applies only outside city limits (an existing assumption, declared false). |
| `NRS_484B_627_1a` / `_1b` | A slow vehicle holding up traffic must keep to the right edge (1a, one lane each way) or use the rightmost lane (1b, two or more lanes). 1b excuses passing a slower vehicle. |
| `NRS_484B_627_1c` | "Use alternate routes whenever possible" can't be checked: nothing in the vocabulary says whether another route exists. I filed an atom gap proposing `st.alternate_route`. |
| `NRS_484B_627_2` | A vehicle must not sit stopped on the roadway while traffic behind it is held up. A stop counts as necessary when the vehicle is queued or a collision is predicted, and as lawful when a sign, signal, officer or railway control requires the halt. |
| `NRS_484B_633_2` | Speed must not exceed the structure-maximum sign on a bridge or elevated structure. Subsection (3), on how the authority investigates and posts, is taken as satisfied when the sign is present. |
| `NRS_484B_653_1a` (surrogate) | Reckless driving is read through extreme speed, or hard acceleration into a predicted conflict. "Premises to which the public has access" uses a new assumption, `asm.public_access_premises`. |

Decisions you may want to review (all also in `PLAN.md` under "For the operator"):
- **"In compliance with law" (627-2):** this only covers halts that a sign, signal, officer or railway control requires. A halt another law requires with nothing displayed, such as for a school bus, is not covered. The validator doesn't allow disclosing that as a narrowing on an exception, so it is only stated in `PLAN.md`. The pending operator gap G22 would cover it fully.
- **NRS 484B.630 (627-1a):** it has no node in the library, so the reference to it is recorded as uncovered text rather than linked to that law.
- **Unknown verdicts in 627-1a, -1b and -1c:** "slow" is measured against a posted maximum. Where no maximum speed sign is present, these rules report unknown.
- **New parameters awaiting review:** `p.narrow_lane_width` (3.0 m), `p.curve_approach_reach` (150 m), `p.impeding_speed_margin` (4.5 m/s). All other parameters repeat earlier batches' proposals unchanged.

I also tried to run the validator's `--help`; the permission check denied it, since that wasn't the one allowed command. It didn't affect the result.

Files are in `iter-001/plan/batch-26/`:
- `blueprint.jsonl`
- `aggregates.jsonl` (empty, since no law-local aggregates)
- `PLAN.md`
